items.text: This version revises a late game overworld screen to prevent a softlock. Due to this, you may find the gameplay objects for this screen missing, if so then just use the on-screen resetter to bring them back. It is also possible if you saved in a very specific spot on the overworld, that you may fall to your death immediately upon load. If this happens, then just undo to continue playing.

KNOWN ISSUE: After the update yesterday we have had reports that reset fails to correctly reset the level. We are looking into this and will hopefully get a fix out soon. In the meantime you should be able to use undo to get back to the start of the level, at which point reset will start working correctly again. This is not so bad in most levels, but for longer levels can be quite annoying. Sorry for the inconvenience!

The previous patch (October 14, r67121) caused issues for anyone who had a partial save of the first Skipping Stones level. We have resolved this by bumping the level version of the level. However, this means that anyone with a partial save will now lose that progress within Skipping Stones. We are _very_ sorry about this, as losing progress is the worst and we try very hard to avoid this, but sadly it was necessary here to avoid problems that were even bigger. To be clear, this progress loss is limited to only this one level; other progress throughout the game is unaffected. On the bright side, it goes pretty fast once you've done it already. If you have already completed the first Skipping Stones level, or haven't played it yet, this will not affect you at all.

releases.displayName: Technical Update on a Beta Branch

items.text: We have posted a TECHNICAL UPDATE for the demo, in a beta branch. To try it, you go to the Properties for the game, go to Game Versions & Betas, and pick public-testing (no password).
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45891839/5e5bf8c7e40da8b1b69f1181a74605bcc9da7457.jpg"]
Optimizations for faster frame rate, especially on lower-end devices! (60fps on most levels on Steam Deck)
A new, lower-profile graphics setting "Very Performance" that can be used on these platforms to achieve these frame rates (or better battery life).
Increased compatibility with older GPUs and systems with less RAM. (Still no shader model 6.5 support, but we are looking at this).
Separate volume controls for music, sound effects and character voice
Control vsync, frame rate cap, and antialiasing mode from the Graphics submenu.
Switch the text language dynamically from the menu without having to fiddle with Steam settings ..
... And more!

First of all, we’d like to thank all of you who have played the Order of the Sinking Star Demo this week already. We’re incredibly grateful for your interest in the game, for your feedback on Discord and in the Steam reviews, and for catapulting Order of the Sinking Star into the Top 5 most-played single-player demos of Steam Next Fest: June 2026 Edition so far!
There are 3 days left to play the demo – as it will be available until Monday, June 22 at 10am PT – so if you haven’t already, jump into the demo and let us know what you think!

Several of you already have completed all the available puzzles in the demo currently... well done! However, your adventure does not end here... we’ve just pushed a content update to the demo, which lets you explore Order of the Sinking Star even more. So, check out the list below for an overview, download the update, and see for yourself what’s new!

notes.title: DEMO UPDATE OVERVIEW: NEW HEROES TO MEET, MORE PUZZLES TO SOLVE, AND MORE TO EXPLORE

items.text: Today’s update (aka Demo Part 2, as Jonathan Blow’s called it!) brings plenty of new content to the Order of the Sinking Star Demo – from new heroes to meet to new mind-bending puzzles to solve.

notes.title: Below’s a quick overview of what today’s update introduces

items.text: New Heroes – The Bard & The Druid: As you solve the intricate puzzles within the demo and unlock new areas to explore, if you progress far enough, you’ll have the chance to meet and play as two new heroes: The Bard and The Druid! With the Bard, she has the ability to charm others and even has the power to move crystals while playing music. The Druid, on the other hand, accidentally transmutes his friends and objects in his path.

A Slew of New Puzzles: For those who’ve finished the demo prior to this update, you know there were 75 puzzles in total. Well, with today’s update, even more puzzles have been added which will officially bring the demo to be over 100 puzzles! Take on the new brain-teasing puzzles – and with the new content, you’ll even have a chance to see what happens when the worlds start to collide...

New Areas to Explore & New Lore to Uncover: With new puzzles comes new areas to explore and of course, new lore to find! Experience even more of the Overworld and uncover even more secrets within Order of the Sinking Star. Will you get one step closer to deciphering this epic tale?
